description: bead-groups data for sprint-group: the attach ref and the relations `sc-compose bead attach` adds with the group. Endpoints are `step:<step>` (a step of this group) or `bead:<id>`, format strings over {vars[<name>]} and, in an `each` relation, {each}. vars, each a list over the sprints the plan file names in depends_on: predecessor_sanity (each one's initial sanity bead) and predecessor_dev (each one's dev bead).

A.description: E1 option A: only dev is poured; the sanity bead is created when dev closes. A predecessor poured under A has no sanity bead yet, so the dependent's dev bead blocks on the predecessor's dev bead.

relations.description: the dependent sprint's dev bead blocks on each predecessor's dev bead (option A pours no sanity bead)

B.description: E1 option B: the poured sanity step has no `needs dev`; sanity and QA each `validates` dev.

relations.description: the dependent sprint's dev bead blocks on each predecessor's initial sanity bead (hard dependency)

C.description: E1 option C, the existing schema: sanity `blocks` dev (poured from `needs`) with metadata.dev_bead; QA `validates` the checked bead.

relations.description: the dependent sprint's dev bead blocks on each predecessor's initial sanity bead (hard dependency)
